name: jobpilot-desktop
author: JobPilot
description: Local-first desktop job search copilot for BOSS Zhipin

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "tsup electron/main.ts electron/preload.ts --format cjs --out-dir dist-electron --external electron --watch" "wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist-electron/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run validate:scripts && tsc --noEmit && vite build && tsup electron/main.ts electron/preload.ts --format cjs --out-dir dist-electron --external electron
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64
scripts.package:all: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64
